metadata.name: Cell — L2 EFE ARBITER (klino CLOSER vs planner SEARCHER; active-inference policy selection)
metadata.description: L-bend maze + 2D-diffusion scent. The L2 EFEArbiter scores each competent loop by Expected Free Energy and gates the MotorBus channel gains winner-take-all (1=drive / 0=mute) with an ADAPTIVE hysteresis margin (no tuned dwell). The two channels are normalised ASYMMETRICALLY because they measure different things: klino = a z-SCORE excitement SPIKE (hunger×scent_max; spikes when scent RISES above its own baseline = food smelled → the near-food CLOSER/approach); planner = a sustained LEVEL = raw_planner / plan_peak ∈[0,1] (the food-route value over its slow-decaying peak; ~1 while routing to remembered food, 0 while exploring, NEVER negative = the far-field SEARCHER/router). Priority: smelling-klino(spike) > planner-with-route(level~1) > blind-klino(z≈0) > planner-exploring(0); a committed food-route HOLDS unless klino genuinely smells food (clean hand-off to close). This replaced the old dual-z-score, which pulled the planner's mean up on a sustained route so its value decayed NEGATIVE mid-route → a blind klino broke the route. Muting routes through the effective fader → 0 authority → that loop's HeadingController advance learning pauses. Watch the value race + gain faders in the v4_inspector EFEArbiter widget. force_policy='' (live) / 'klino' / 'planner' / 'shuffle' = the ablation controls. (energy_drain is a DEMONSTRATION knob for the nested-blanket interoceptive hunger signal — not a survival/evolution claim.)
metadata._comment_scent: publish_scent_ring=false → the body virtualizes scent POSITION-ONLY (a scalar sampled at the bug's centre, frame-independent 'bath'). The directional 8-nostril ring (reality.proprio.scent) is a scaffold / different sensory modality and is fully bypassed here — nothing in this config consumes it (klino=RunTumbleNav is scalar run-and-tumble, direction emerges from motion). Defensible chemotaxis: no directional read of the source.

params._comment_ortho: ORTHOKINESIS ON THE TUMBLE RATE (live slider) — the plain-tumble A/B CONTROL keeps this at 0 (E. coli run length). Set >0 (e.g. 4) to SHORTEN runs near food for a coarse→fine close (p_tumble scales with the self-calibrated proximity cap∈[0,1]); long approach runs preserved far away. See the_cell_arbiter_ortho.json (=this + level_gain 4) for the shipped orthokinetic close. Powered L-bend battery: level_gain=4 = 3/4 envs more eats + lower ticks-since-food all 4.

params._comment: LEARNED advance (genuine 'act on a heading') + wedge-escape safety net + explore-on-lost. Defensible action layer.
params._comment_hk: advance_homeokinetic: reward = max(0,vel_fwd) − effort·|vel_fwd| (food-DECOUPLED, intrinsic controllable motion). No cos(bearing) → off-axis forward not punished → off-axis forward is no longer punished into NEGATIVE; the table STILL flattens to ~0 when STUCK (reward 0 → EMA → 0) — the hunger-gated escape recovers it. nav+turn-priority handle aiming.

params._comment: QUICK KICK away from walls: HOLD steer-away for pulse_ticks (effective impulse), then refractory release so the cog resurfaces, drives, and LEARNS the turn. pulse_ticks + refractory_ticks are live HotMutable sliders — tune the kick feel to taste.
MISMATCH stuck: commands motion but doesn't achieve it (|afferent|<<|intended|). Self-normalizing, no velocity threshold. Turning/idle (intended~0) never fires. refractory 120.

L2 active-inference policy selection. scoring_mode='efe' (ACTIVE): each policy scored as an EXPECTED FREE ENERGY G = pragmatic (hunger×reach-prob) + epistemic ((1−hunger)×uncertainty-reduction). The two PRAGMATIC terms share units (hunger×reach-prob) so the klino/planner scale mismatch is gone BY CONSTRUCTION — no cede, no plan_peak self-norm, no max-of-three. klino reach-prob = its eat-calibrated capability (cap→1 in its own eating range); planner reach-prob = its DISCOUNTED route value (γ^hops<1 to a remembered cache) → near food g_prag_klino=hunger>hunger·γ^hops so klino OWNS THE CLOSE decisively. klino epistemic = the z-spike (scent rising = 'food this way', wins the approach); hunger sets the exploit↔explore balance (no tuned λ). vs value_race (the legacy asymmetric z-score/level race). winner-take-all with margin=hysteresis_k·running_std(G_klino−G_planner). Hard gains 1/0 → MotorBus arbiter.gain.<name>. Watch the four-term race + precision meters in the v4_inspector EFEArbiter widget. force_policy ablations: ''=live / 'klino' / 'planner' / 'shuffle'. seed42 300s: efe 4 eats / hunger 0.19 vs value_race 2 eats / hunger 0.26 (efe hands the fast direct forager more authority when sated → breaks the planner-crawl starvation).

proportional_mix = TURN-PRIORITY: cog passes linear below unity (gain 0.75 keeps it off the limiter → headroom for the steer differential + the whisker pulse, channels linked). The turn gets range first (can drive the opposite paddle negative = pivot → tight radius ~6.5 vs 8.8); forward yields. Fixes the wide-arc. cog gain is a live slider: ↑ = faster forward/wider, ↓ = tighter.
params._comment_tb: turn_brake=3: forward yields hard to the turn so the bug pivots-in to the food (converge) instead of orbiting it — needed because the homeokinetic advance drives forward-always. Live slider.
params._comment_arbiter: gain_mod_prefix wires planner→arbiter.gain.planner, klino→arbiter.gain.klino (whisker/stuck have no arbiter gain → default 1.0, safety layer never muted). effective_gain = base · arbiter → mix AND authority, so the muted loop gets 0 authority and its advance learning pauses. Base gains 0.75 → a 1.0 arbiter gain passes the loop under the limiter; a 0.0 mutes it cleanly.
